purpose: Cloud control binding, transactional PostgreSQL schema, ControlStore protocol, and immutable run ownership

ownership_model.rule: Immutable ownership per run; set at creation, never altered or migrated across runtimes

hf05_sqlite.description: Local standalone SQLite runtime for local development, offline mode, and zero-cost fast tests

df11_legacy.description: Historical legacy runs executed under DF-11 native SQLite orchestrator; read-only preservation

cloud_dbos_postgres.description: Production and VPS durable runtime powered by PostgreSQL 16+ and DBOS Python v2.31.1

invariants: No migration script or binary converter transforms SQLite checkpoints into DBOS/PostgreSQL rows.
Runs initiated in hf05_sqlite conclude in hf05_sqlite.
Runs initiated in cloud_dbos_postgres conclude in cloud_dbos_postgres.
Runs originating from df11_legacy remain immutable and archived for audit trail purposes.
Fallback from cloud to local switches runner engine for NEW runs, leaving in-flight cloud runs preserved in PostgreSQL.

IntakeCommand.description: Canonical intake command submitted via external channels (Telegram, DarkHub, CLI, Webhook)

external_id.description: External message or event ID for idempotency deduplication

payload.description: Structured demand specification containing title, problem, journey, non_goals, and criteria

mode.description: Execution mode: autonomous launches orchestrator run; documentary creates record without launching run

IntakeReceipt.description: Deterministic receipt issued upon intake acceptance

demand_id.description: Unique demand identifier, derived or assigned deterministically

run_id.description: Assigned orchestrator run ID; non-empty in autonomous mode, null in documentary mode

initial_job_id.description: Assigned initial job ID (e.g. Grill stage); non-empty in autonomous mode, null in documentary mode

JobKey.description: Strict composite key identifying an atomic stage execution unit; never represented as an ambiguous delimited string

iteration.description: Zero-indexed execution attempt or replanning iteration

Claim.description: Exclusive distributed lease awarded to an identified worker for a specific JobKey

lease_id.description: Unique lease identifier (UUID v4 or nanoid)

fencing_token.description: Monotonic fencing token for optimistic concurrency and fencing against zombie workers

route_ref.description: Routing qualification reference used to claim the job

StageContext.description: Immutable context provided to StageHandler for execution

claim.description: Active claim proving lease ownership and fencing token

plan_ref.description: Canonical path or identifier of plan artifact

candidate_digest.description: Git commit SHA or candidate digest under test, if applicable

route_ref.description: Resolved model routing key or profile

input_refs.description: List of input artifact references required by stage

StageResult.description: Terminal or intermediate outcome emitted by StageHandler

output_refs.description: Produced artifact paths or hashes; required for outcome=success

evidence_refs.description: Verification logs, receipts, or test evidence

operation_refs.description: Keys of external operations performed during stage

actual_cost.description: Total monetary cost in USD consumed during stage execution

cause_code.description: Error or categorization code explaining failure or retry reason

validation_invariants: outcome == 'success' requires output_refs to be non-empty
approved=true is strictly forbidden as an evidence substitute

ExternalOperation.description: Idempotent record of side-effecting external operations (e.g. Telegram send, GitHub PR, Dokploy deploy)

operation_key.description: Globally unique deterministic idempotency key for the operation

request_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical request payload

external_id.description: Provider-assigned identifier once acknowledged (e.g. message_id, pr_number, deploy_id)

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when operation state was recorded

ReconcilePage.description: Paginated report generated by reconciliation sweeper

repaired_keys.description: List of jobs, claims, or outbox records repaired during sweep

next_cursor.description: Next pagination cursor, null if sweep completed

cycle_id.description: Unique identifier of the reconciliation sweep cycle

protocol_specification.description: Canonical transactional control store interface abstracting PostgreSQL (cloud) and SQLite (local)

accept.description: Accepts an intake command transactionally with idempotency checking. If the same external_id exists with identical payload hash, returns existing receipt. If payload differs, raises IdempotencyConflict. In autonomous mode, atomically inserts run, initial job, and outbox event.

claim.signature: claim(worker: str, capabilities: list[str], now: datetime) -> Claim | None
claim.description: Atomically queries and locks the next pending job matching worker capabilities (using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED in PostgreSQL). Advances fencing_token by +1, establishes lease with expires_at = now + lease_duration_sec, and returns Claim. Returns None if no eligible job exists.

heartbeat.description: Extends claim expiration to now + lease_duration_sec iff claim.fencing_token matches current database state and lease has not expired/been stolen. Returns updated Claim. Raises StaleLeaseError if token is stale.

finish.signature: finish(claim: Claim, result: StageResult, now: datetime) -> None
finish.description: Concludes active job execution in a single atomic transaction iff fencing_token is current. Records StageResult, releases claim, updates job status, registers successors if success, or triggers retry/replan logic, and writes successor dispatch events to outbox.

materialize.signature: materialize(event: dict[str, Any], now: datetime) -> None
materialize.description: Marks an outbox event as dispatched or processed. Used by the background outbox publisher after successfully launching a DBOS workflow or notifying external services.

reconcile.signature: reconcile(now: datetime, cursor: str | None = None, limit: int = 100) -> ReconcilePage
reconcile.description: Scans for expired claims (now > expires_at with status 'active'), transitions them to 'expired', and re-queues affected jobs if retries remain or marks them failed. Sweeps unmaterialized outbox rows and resolves unknown external operations.

get_operation.description: Fetches recorded ExternalOperation by operation_key to ensure external side effects are never re-executed blindly upon crash recovery or retry.

record_operation.description: Atomically inserts or updates an ExternalOperation within the context of an active claim and fencing token. Validates that claim is current before saving.

tables.description: Master execution runs instantiated from accepted autonomous intake commands
Atomic execution stages belonging to a run, identified by composite 5-tuple
Distributed leases awarded to workers for exclusive job execution
Transactional outbox for reliable at-least-once event delivery to DBOS and external workers
Idempotency ledger for external side-effect operations executed by stages
Audit trail of automated self-healing sweeps and lease expirations

ddl_schema_postgresql.ddl_script:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
    run_id VARCHAR(160) PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    demand_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    demand_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    runtime_owner VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (runtime_owner IN ('hf05_sqlite', 'df11_legacy', 'cloud_dbos_postgres')),
    mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('autonomous', 'documentary')),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    plan_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    config_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT uq_runs_project_demand UNIQUE (project_id, demand_id, demand_version)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (
    run_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    ticket_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    plan_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    iteration INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (iteration >= 0),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'succeeded', 'retry', 'replan', 'waiting_dependency', 'waiting_human', 'cancelled', 'failed')),
    role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    required_capabilities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    fencing_token INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    current_lease_id VARCHAR(160),
    timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800,
    retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    max_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
    cause_code VARCHAR(64),
    actual_cost NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0000,
    output_refs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    evidence_refs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, ticket_id, plan_version, stage, iteration)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_claim_lookup ON jobs (status, role) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_run_id ON jobs (run_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claims (
    lease_id VARCHAR(160) PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    ticket_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    plan_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    iteration INTEGER NOT NULL,
    owner VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    fencing_token INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reservation_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    route_ref VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    acquired_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'released', 'expired', 'stolen')),
    FOREIGN KEY (run_id, ticket_id, plan_version, stage, iteration) REFERENCES jobs(run_id, ticket_id, plan_version, stage, iteration) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT uq_claims_job_fencing UNIQUE (run_id, ticket_id, plan_version, stage, iteration, fencing_token)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_claims_expiry_sweep ON claims (expires_at, status) WHERE status = 'active';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox (
    outbox_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    aggregate_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL,
    target_system VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cloud_dbos',
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'published', 'failed', 'dead_letter')),
    retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    error_message TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_pending_dispatch ON outbox (status, created_at) WHERE status = 'pending';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS external_operations (
    operation_key VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY,
    request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    external_id VARCHAR(256),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('prepared', 'sent', 'unknown', 'succeeded', 'failed')),
    claim_lease_id VARCHAR(160),
    fencing_token INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    response_digest VARCHAR(64),
    error_details TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ext_ops_provider_status ON external_operations (provider, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_ledger (
    entry_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    cycle_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_key JSONB NOT NULL,
    reason VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('success', 'failed', 'skipped')),
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recon_cycle_time ON reconciliation_ledger (cycle_id, recorded_at);

dispatch_flow: 1. Business transaction in PostgreSQL mutates jobs/runs and writes event row to outbox in single BEGIN...COMMIT.
2. Background outbox publisher polls outbox WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY outbox_id ASC LIMIT 50 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
4. Upon DBOS acknowledgement, publisher updates outbox row to status = 'published', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
5. On transient failure, publisher increments retry_count with exponential backoff.
6. If worker crashes after DBOS launch but before outbox update, subsequent dispatch with identical workflow_id is safely deduplicated by DBOS system tables.

crash_before_commit.state_impact: Zero state change in database; no locks held; no outbox events written
crash_before_commit.recovery_action: Client receives connection error; safely retries transaction with identical idempotency key

crash_during_execution_post_claim.detection: Worker heartbeat ceases; now > expires_at (45s lease expired)
crash_during_execution_post_claim.state_impact: Job remains in status 'running' with expired claim
crash_during_execution_post_claim.recovery_action: Reconciliation sweeper identifies expired claim, updates claim status to 'expired', resets job status to 'pending' with retry_count incremented, and advances fencing_token.

zombie_worker_resurrection.detection: Stale worker attempts finish() or heartbeat() with old fencing_token
zombie_worker_resurrection.recovery_action: ControlStore rejects operation immediately with StaleLeaseError; no outputs, evidence, or state changes written

crash_during_external_operation.detection: ExternalOperation status remains 'prepared' or 'sent' without terminal outcome
crash_during_external_operation.recovery_action: Retrying worker or reconciler executes get_operation(key), queries external provider before initiating call; never blindly re-executes external side effect

crash_during_outbox_publish.detection: Outbox row remains 'pending' while DBOS workflow may have been launched
crash_during_outbox_publish.recovery_action: DBOS deterministic workflow_id deduplication guarantees duplicate launch is a no-op returning existing workflow handle

points: Hybrid local-first architecture strictly preserved: Native SQLite for local development and CI, PostgreSQL + DBOS for VPS cloud.
Zero checkpoint conversion: SQLite checkpoints and PostgreSQL databases remain distinct and unmerged.
Zero domain contamination: No DBOS imports, decorators, or schemas in core/workflow/ domain types.
Secret handling: Database URL passed strictly via SecretReference(DARKFAC_HF02_DATABASE_URL), never printed in logs or CLI arguments.
